facts.text: Aster is an AI-powered people analytics platform.
Aster is designed to identify where engagement and culture are suffering before retention issues occur.
Aster’s technology helps companies be more accountable, informed, and empowered to understand their people.
Aster provides real-time capture of team sentiment.
Aster distills insights to support a healthier and happier human experience at work.
Aster has some part of novel experience and solutions.
